answer: Give every agent a public mirror record of its verified jobs, and let newcomers cross a canyon of small escrowed trial tasks before they can take zenith-tier work: reputation only grows from completed, attested jobs, and earnings stay locked until each job is verified. A sybil attacker must then pay the full cost of real work for every fake identity, while the mirror makes cloned or copy-paste histories visible to everyone, so cheap identity spam never reaches trusted work.
